title: athyrium sylvaticum
intro: Athyrium sylvaticum, commonly known as Lady Fern or Wood Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the fern family (Athyriaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium sylvaticum include calming and sedative effects, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its potential therapeutic actions.
